biggest_catch: You earn only when someone buys through your links — zero guaranteed sales or campaigns — and commissions sit pending 30–120 days before they can be paid.
catches: ZERO GUARANTEED EARNINGS: commissions are earned only on purchases made through your ShopMy affiliate links; no sales, no pay — nothing is guaranteed.
BRAND-SELECTION RISK: which brands you can link and promote depends on brand/retailer participation in affiliate programs integrated with ShopMy.
VARIABLE PAY: 'Commission rates on these products typically range from 10% to 30%, depending on the brand or retailer' — rates are brand-set, not fixed.
CONTENT RIGHTS: you create and share product content that drives sales; exact content-usage and rights terms are in ShopMy's creator agreement — read them before posting.
PENDING WINDOW: 'commissions typically remain pending for 30 to 120 days, even if the retailer's return window has already ended' before moving to Locked and becoming payable.
MINIMUM PAYOUT: you must have at least $11 under 'Next Payment' to qualify for a weekly deposit.

steps: Create a ShopMy creator account and complete the creator setup.
Add products to your account — ShopMy automatically converts them into ShopMy affiliate links via its integrations with retailer and brand affiliate programs.
Share your ShopMy affiliate links with your audience (social, blog, newsletter).
When a purchase is made, the commission enters Pending status while the retailer closes its return window, verifies the transaction, and pays ShopMy.
Once ShopMy receives the funds, your commission moves to Locked (typically 30–120 days after purchase).
Track your payment history under the 'My Earnings' tab in the Payments section.
Receive a single streamlined payment via Stripe or PayPal every Friday, once you have at least $11 under 'Next Payment.'
timing: Payouts occur weekly, every Friday, for Locked commissions once the $11 'Next Payment' minimum is met. Commissions typically remain pending 30–120 days before locking.
